title: Underlying equivalences and operadic colimits of coherent modules
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent functors, mapping spaces and universes of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and monoidal infinity-categories of [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category]. Let $\mathcal V$ be a monoidal infinity-category and $\mathcal M$ an infinity-category with a coherent left action $\otimes:\mathcal V\times\mathcal M\to\mathcal M$: the equivalences $(v\otimes w)\otimes m\simeq v\otimes(w\otimes m)$ and $\mathbf1\otimes m\simeq m$ include all associative and unital higher compatibilities. An associative algebra $B$ in $\mathcal V$ has a multiplication $B\otimes B\to B$, a unit $\mathbf1\to B$ and their coherent compatibilities. A left $B$-module in $\mathcal M$ has an action $B\otimes m\to m$ with all coherent associativity and unit data; $\operatorname{LMod}_B(\mathcal M)$ retains the coherent action-preserving maps and their higher simplices. All categories and mapping spaces are taken in sufficiently large universes. Fix $B$ and let $U:\operatorname{LMod}_B(\mathcal M)\to\mathcal M$ forget the action. A morphism of left $B$-modules is an equivalence if and only if its image under $U$ is an equivalence.

Let $K$ be a small simplicial set, let $p:K\to\operatorname{LMod}_B(\mathcal M)$ be a coherent diagram, and suppose there is a colimiting cocone $c:Up\to\Delta_K m$ in $\mathcal M$ such that $v\otimes c$ is colimiting for every $v\in\mathcal V$. Then $p$ admits a colimiting cocone whose underlying cocone is equivalent to $c$. Under these hypotheses an arbitrary cocone $\widetilde c:p\to\Delta_K N$ in $\operatorname{LMod}_B(\mathcal M)$ is colimiting if and only if $U\widetilde c$ is colimiting in $\mathcal M$. The preservation hypothesis concerns only the specified cocone $c$, not every diagram of shape $K$.
